notes: The approved grid prints 13 rows. More may be recorded — the first 13 fill the printed grid and the rest are carried onto a continuation page, which is what the paper form's own 'attach additional pages' convention does.

Each attendee signs their own row. A signature is a signature wherever it appears, so the column is declared type 'signature' and its cells are image boxes in the field map — drawn on screen, stamped as a mark, never typed.
